name: INTRESSANT spice mill, oiled solid acacia, 27 cm (IKEA Israel)

warm-modern.reason: Estimate: oiled acacia is warm and has a ceramic grinder, but acacia is lighter than the walnut the spec wants and the 27 cm height is 7-9 cm over the 18-20 spec.

safety.source: IKEA Israel product page; food-contact claim not stated on the part read

notes: Spec (gap 11): a pair of WALNUT mills, 18-20 cm, ceramic mechanism, no painted cap. This is a single mill, sold one per article, so a pair means two units (138 ILS). Height 27 vs 18-20 is a size miss (boundary, not a silent rejection). Alternative-only (IKEA). Shipping to Israel: cheapest = IKEA Israel standard delivery or pickup (not verified); fastest = not published. Hex estimated; images not downloaded; rights unclear.
